_how_to_use: Your notes for the Command Center's Knowledge base tab. Add an entry to the top of `entries` whenever you write a document, make a decision or hit a question. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind (document | decision | question | note), title, text, and optional path (a file in this repo) and story (a story id). The page reads this file at runtime, so nothing else needs changing.

entries.title: The Command Center reads repo files only
entries.text: No admin endpoint and no token. Every tab reads .colaberry/plan.json, progress.json and manifest.json at runtime, so the page stays static and holds no secret.
